templates.description: Pixel shader with no input TOP — generates a procedural color from uTime and UV coordinates. Good for animated test patterns, noise, gradients.
Pixel shader reading from a single input TOP via sTD2DInputs[0]. Skeleton for invert / threshold / displace / per-pixel filters.
Pixel shader blending two input TOPs by a uniform 'mix_amount'. Add a Vectors/Constants param on the GLSL TOP with Uniform Name = mix_amount to drive it from a CHOP or slider.
Compute shader writing into mTDComputeOutputs[0]. Set Shader Type = Compute Shader on the GLSL TOP. Local size 8x8 is a sane default; tune for your output resolution.

uniforms_reference.name: uTime
uniforms_reference.desc: Project absolute time in seconds since start.

uniforms_reference.name: uTDPass
uniforms_reference.desc: Current pass index when using multi-pass cooking.

uniforms_reference.name: vUV
uniforms_reference.desc: Interpolated UV coords from the vertex shader. Use vUV.st for 2D coords (0..1).

uniforms_reference.name: sTD2DInputs[N]
uniforms_reference.desc: Array of input TOPs samplers. sTD2DInputs[0] = first input, etc. Use texture() not the deprecated texture2D().

uniforms_reference.name: uTDOutputInfo
uniforms_reference.desc: Output info struct. uTDOutputInfo.res.zw = output (width, height) in pixels; .res.xy = 1/(w,h) for normalization.

uniforms_reference.name: mTDComputeOutputs[N]
uniforms_reference.desc: Write-target images for compute shaders. Use imageStore(mTDComputeOutputs[i], coord, color).

uniforms_reference.name: TDOutputSwizzle(vec4)
uniforms_reference.desc: MANDATORY final wrapper on any color you write to fragColor or imageStore. Applies TD's color management swizzle. Skipping it will silently produce wrong colors on some output pipelines.

uniforms_reference.name: <custom uniform>
uniforms_reference.desc: Declare with `uniform <type> <name>;` and bind via the GLSL TOP's Vectors / Constants params (Uniform Name field).

antipatterns.desc: TD requires TDOutputSwizzle() on every fragColor / imageStore color. Without it, colors look wrong (typically too dark, or RGB swapped) in certain TD output paths even if it looks fine in the viewer.
texture2D() is GLSL ES 1.0 / pre-130 syntax. TD GLSL TOP uses GLSL 330+. Use texture() instead.
Adding #version yourself conflicts with TD's auto-prepended header. Let TD inject it.
Compute shaders require a layout(local_size_x/y/z) declaration. Without it, the shader will not compile.
When dispatch size doesn't match output resolution exactly, threads outside the output write garbage or skip writes. Always early-return on out-of-bounds.
antipatterns.wrong: void main() { ivec2 c = ivec2(gl_GlobalInvocationID.xy); imageStore(mTDComputeOutputs[0], c, col); }
antipatterns.right: vec2 res = vec2(uTDOutputInfo.res.zw);\nif (coord.x >= int(res.x) || coord.y >= int(res.y)) return;
